title: Raw data fill 84% of PRIDE’s 2.71 petabytes; final result tables are 4% of what results zips hold
sub:
(a) Stored bytes of all 3.03 million top-level files in the 36,249 study datasets, by file layer. (b) Uncompressed bytes inside the
45,985 results zips whose member list could be read (55.3 of 68.9 TB of non-raw archives; rar, 7z and tar cannot be listed),
by role of each member file (assigned from file names). The two panels use different scales.
